slices.focus: A family challenges a church affiliation tag, forcing Ariana to build correction and accountability processes
slices.summary: A family challenges an incorrect church affiliation on a public record, revealing that trust requires transparent correction mechanisms. Ariana meets the family in person, creates a community correction form, implements sensitive-field review, and drafts language about corrections being part of archive life.
open_loops: Launching the correction form (simple version first)
Locking in sensitive-field review before new records publish
Polishing the site explanation about documented changes after mechanics are live
Conducting a triage pass on church, school, and organization tags already online
